root_event_set_filter.purpose: Anchors Level 1 (LVL1_CODE = A.PARENT_EVENT_SET_CD) at the root of the Cerner Open Clinical Foundation (OCF) Event Set Hierarchy (ESH).

v500_source_tables.role: Event set definition and display lookup (EVENT_SET_CD, EVENT_SET_NAME, EVENT_SET_CD_DISP, EVENT_SET_CD_DEFINITION).
Parent-child grouper hierarchy edges (PARENT_EVENT_SET_CD -> EVENT_SET_CD, EVENT_SET_COLLATING_SEQ). Traversed across 9 self-joins (A..I) to produce 10 hierarchy levels (LVL1_CODE..LVL10_CODE).
Pre-exploded closure bridge mapping any grouper or primitive EVENT_SET_CD (BOTTOM_LEVEL_EVENT_SET_CODE) directly to leaf EVENT_CD (Code Set 72).
Resolves leaf EVENT_CD (Code Set 72) display string (CV.DISPLAY AS EVENT_DISPLAY).
Scanned in Transformation 2 (insert_orphans) to identify charted EVENT_CD values not linked to any active event set under ALL OCF EVENT SETS.

md_d_event_set_search.ccl_equivalent_prg:
SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    lvl1_cd = a.parent_event_set_cd
  , lvl1_disp = par_disp.event_set_cd_disp
  , lvl2_cd = a.event_set_cd
  , lvl2_disp = cld_disp.event_set_cd_disp
  , lvl3_cd = b.event_set_cd
  , lvl3_disp = b_disp.event_set_cd_disp
  , bottom_event_set_cd = evaluate(c.event_set_cd, 0.0, evaluate(b.event_set_cd, 0.0, a.event_set_cd, b.event_set_cd), c.event_set_cd)
  , event_cd = expd.event_cd
  , event_disp = uar_get_code_display(expd.event_cd)
FROM
    v500_event_set_code root_esc
  , v500_event_set_canon a
  , v500_event_set_code par_disp
  , v500_event_set_code cld_disp
  , v500_event_set_canon b
  , v500_event_set_code b_disp
  , v500_event_set_canon c
  , v500_event_set_explode expd
PLAN root_esc
  WHERE root_esc.event_set_cd_definition = "ALL OCF EVENT SETS"
JOIN a
  WHERE a.parent_event_set_cd = root_esc.event_set_cd
JOIN par_disp
  WHERE par_disp.event_set_cd = a.parent_event_set_cd
JOIN cld_disp
  WHERE cld_disp.event_set_cd = a.event_set_cd
JOIN b
  WHERE b.parent_event_set_cd = outerjoin(a.event_set_cd)
JOIN b_disp
  WHERE b_disp.event_set_cd = outerjoin(b.event_set_cd)
JOIN c
  WHERE c.parent_event_set_cd = outerjoin(b.event_set_cd)
JOIN expd
  WHERE expd.event_set_cd = a.event_set_cd
WITH nocounter, separator = " ", format
